tables.label: Field-Goal Percentage
tables.qualification: Minimum 51 appearance(s) and 720 attempts (10 × league team-game benchmark).

tables.label: Three-Point Percentage
tables.qualification: Minimum 51 appearance(s) and 360 attempts (5 × league team-game benchmark).

tables.label: Free-Throw Percentage
tables.qualification: Minimum 51 appearance(s) and 360 attempts (5 × league team-game benchmark).

tables.label: Effective FG%
tables.qualification: Minimum 51 appearance(s) and 720 field-goal attempts. (FGM + 0.5 × 3PM) / FGA.

tables.label: True Shooting%
tables.qualification: Minimum 51 appearance(s) and 720 field-goal attempts. PTS / [2 × (FGA + 0.44 × FTA)].

tables.label: Assist / Turnover Ratio
tables.qualification: Minimum 51 appearance(s), 216 assists and one turnover. Zero-turnover ratios are undefined.
